fact: The World Bank status report of 13 February 2025 says AFOR has operationalised digital applications (DIGIFOR, SCCARTO), that SIFOR is not yet the official rural land registry (ordonnance pending), and that the 95 percent digitisation of existing certificates and reconfiguration of SIFOR for customary registration were not yet achieved.
title: Implementation Status & Results Report: Côte d’Ivoire Rural Land Tenure Management Strengthening Program (P179338)
